text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspections I5, I6, which must performed 
 every 6 months and on an annually bases as mentioned by M6, Y1 in the title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by: eng. Saleh Abdou, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Abaas & eng Tawfeek Ramadan, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Tawfeek Elabasery, accepted by general manager eng Tarek 
 Youssef 
 Ali, approved by eng Mechaeal George Habashy head sector of Ayoun Moussa 
 power station, and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. Inspection & 
 quality control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear the appropriate safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet,
 earplug .... etc
Generator must be out 
 of service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Megger 5000V, Grease injector
Work to be carried out
Every Six Months
Check 
 exciter end generator bearing and shaft seal insulation.
Re-greasing 
 devices of vapor exhauster shaft seals with grease.
Drain 
 liquid from compressed air filter.
Check slip 
 ring surface. (At rotor standstill)

 exciter end generator bearing and shaft seal insulation.

Drain 
 liquid from compressed air filter.
Check slip 
 ring surface. (At rotor standstill)
Annually
Measure 
 insulation resistance.
Check shut 
 off valve of gas supply for function and free movement.
Check gas 
 supply line, shut off valves and solenoids on gas tightness.
